[[Tubeline Bridge]] }} '''School of Hard Knocks''' (Japanese: '''VS プロトーガ''' ''VS Tirtouga''), titled '''VS Tirtouga''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 499th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 39th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black & White}}. It is subtitled '''Tirtouga''' (Japanese: '''暴走''' ''Wild-riding'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''School of Hard Knocks''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * [[Brycen]] discovers that {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}} has been awakened. * {{adv|Black}} meets the {{ci|Opelucid}} [[Gym Leader]], [[Drayden]]. * Black discovers that [[Iris]] is being trained by [[Drayden]]. * Iris has a quick battle with [[Drayden]], but loses. * Black faces the {{tc|Biker|Black Empoleon biker gang}} and defeats them. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Druddigon}} ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Black}} * {{adv|White}} (fantasy) * [[Lenora]] (fantasy) * [[Burgh]] (fantasy) * [[Elesa]] (fantasy) * [[Clay]] (fantasy) * [[Skyla]] (fantasy) * [[Brycen]] * [[Drayden]] * [[Iris]] * {{tc|Doctor}} Logan * {{tc|Biker}} Jeremy * {{tc|Biker|Black Empoleon bikers}} ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Munna}} ([[Musha]];
